method: Gaussian latent with correlation c shared by the two contexts of each seed; 8 seeds x 2 parents; 300 reps; 300 permutations and 300 bootstraps per rep (lighter than the scorer)
decision: upper-bound criterion 0.6: under the null 67% NO-TRANSFER, 4% TRANSFER, rest INCONCLUSIVE; under c=0.6, 69% TRANSFER and 7% NO-TRANSFER. A NO-TRANSFER verdict therefore bounds a transferable component below roughly c=0.6, not zero.
